label: GO after a rare-rewarded a1 trial (a1 -> S2, rewarded), late in the episode (trial >= 85)
explanation: Fires only at GO (D1 and D2 essentially never), and only in the last ~15 trials of an episode (none before trial 80; 92% of mass in trials 90-99, where the value head is lowest). The strongest activations come at GO right after the previous trial was a1 with a rare transition to S2 that was rewarded, which is evidence that S2 is good, and the agent then switches to a2. Top windows reach about 1.0 of max exactly there. The predicate uses only observed history plus episode position (no future variables). Dev P=0.83, R=0.55, mass recall 0.77. The missed activations are mostly weak (bottom two quartiles): other late-episode GO steps, often after common-a2 or other rewarded trials. Magnitude is largest for rare-rewarded-a1 and small elsewhere. It does not fire after a rare-rewarded a2 trial (prev_action=2 has 10% of mass), after unrewarded trials (5% of mass), or at any step before trial 80.
